214  THE SAVOY MALE AND FEMALE COLLEGE

            Mr. W. H. Davis
            Miss Lou A. Arterberry

    Honorable Sam Rayburn made the address of the day, which was followed by the formal dedication of the building, the Halsell Memorial Gymnasium.

    Mr. Thomasson's address and dedication, the acceptance address on behalf of the founders by Mrs. Annie Halsell Woodward, and the acceptance address on behalf of the sponsors made by Mr. J. Wesley Moulton, Superintendent of the Savoy Schools, are given here in full.


DEDICATION CEREMONY

THE HALSELL MEMORIAL GYMNASIUM
WPA PROJECTS NOS. 5023 AND 9708

Savoy, Fannin County, Texas

Sunday, August 7, 1938

2:00 P.M.

PROGRAM

Chairman of the Day: W. P. Carter, President Savoy Independent School Board.
Music: Woodmen Circle Band of Sherman
Invocation: Dr. William Deatherage, Dallas.
Welcome Address: Hon. J. B. May, Mayor of Savoy
Response: Hon. Mark McMahon, Fort Worth.
Descendants of Founders:
    S. D. (Doak) Halsell, Durant, Okla.
    Mrs. Annie Halsell Woodward, Durant, Okla.
    Mrs. Mattie Halsell Toon, Caney, Okla.
    And others
Song: Miss Cornelia Roberts, Savoy.
Address: Hon. Sam Rayburn, M. C., Bonham
Music:
Address and Dedication: Gus W. Thomasson
    (Administrative Field Officer, WPA, Dallas Area)
people: Mrs. W. B. (Lee Lindsay) De Jarnett
notes: WPA Projects Nos. 5023 and 9708. Lists the ten surviving members of Professor Halsell's first class of forty-eight pupils.
